Alex Kim: Looping folks — candidate Liam O'Neill is coming onsite Tue Apr 12. He's flying in SFO arriving 8:30am. Interview window 9:00–16:00 PT. Need panel availability, access/badge, parking permit, lunch dietary prefs, and confirmation of room setup (dual monitor + whiteboard).
Maria Gonzalez: I can cover 9:00–11:00. I'll take lunch logistics. Liam mentioned vegetarian. @OnboardBot can you start a temp badge request and parking? :white_check_mark:
OnboardBot: Badge request submitted (req# 2026-042). Waiting on security approval. Parking permit placeholder created.
Devon Reed: I can join 13:00–15:00 but prefer 14:00–15:00 for the coding slot. We should reserve a room with HDMI + spare keyboard. Is there a short take-home or in-person exercise?
Alex Kim: We'll run a 45min in-person coding exercise at 14:00 in Conf A, followed by 30min debrief. I'll book Conf A and label it "Coding Exercise - HDMI required". Agenda and instructions will be attached to the invite.
Talya Singh: Candidate asked about transit and reimbursement. Offer Lyft ride from airport (cap $80) + standard meals. I'll add expense guideline link. Also he requested CART captioning — we should confirm live captions for the panel.
Maria Gonzalez: Noted on accessibility. I'll arrange live captions via our Zoom room and in-person CART provider for the interview. Please add to invite: "Live captions available — contact Maria if you need anything else."
Alex Kim: Draft agenda (will include in calendar invite):
```
09:00 - 09:15  Welcome & check-in (Reception)
09:15 - 10:00  Team intro / behavioral
10:15 - 11:00  Product deep-dive
11:00 - 12:00  Lunch (Maria picks up)
13:00 - 13:45  System design
14:00 - 14:45  Coding exercise (Conf A; bring laptop + HDMI)
15:00 - 15:30  Debrief & wrap
```
Also adding Zoom link for remote panelists: `https://zoom.us/j/1234567890`
Devon Reed: Perfect. I'll bring a spare keyboard and adapter.
Maria Gonzalez: I'll meet them at reception at 08:45 and walk them to Conf A.
OnboardBot: Calendar invite sent to panel and candidate. Parking permit code: RDW-4721 (display at kiosk). Badge will be at reception under "Liam O'Neill". Expense form: https://redwood.example/exp-forms. Security approval expected by EOD tomorrow.
Alex Kim: Thanks all — please react to the calendar invite to confirm. If any conflicts pop up, flag here and we'll reshuffle. :pray:
